disambiguation: The dashed arrows show the sequence of visits, not the actual physical route traveled.
extras: The plugin has no account, analytics, advertising, or telemetry.
intentEvidence: Footprint Map renders a local, time-ordered travel diary from photo locations inside Obsidian.
problem: Users lack a way to visualize their travel history and sequence of locations simply by reviewing photos taken during a trip.
summary: Footprint Map renders a time-ordered travel diary by extracting GPS and timestamp metadata from local photos and visualizing the journey on an interactive map.
